_comment: Canonical shapes for the diagnostics / support commands (spec §44.11,
TypeScript wrappers in src/control/services/diagnostics.ts emit and
Neither command takes an argument. export_support_bundle used to declare
`destination: String`, which the webview had no way to supply — the dialog
plugin is deliberately not granted to JavaScript — so the call would have
failed to deserialize before running a line (the C5 shape). Rust runs the
folder picker itself and returns null when the operator cancels.
_session_count_comment: sessionCount is deliberately 0 in this fixture. Nothing wrote the sessions
table until start_session was wired, so a zero on an existing install
means 'not recorded', not 'never presented'. The UI must qualify it.
